notes.title: Update 1_16 and April Tournament Winners!
notes.content:
Hey all, I just pushed out the remastered update! This updates includes a couple new scenery updates as well as some polished UI changes. This is mainly because Glider Island will be on the Oculus Store soon and I wanted to clean up some things before releasing there!

You will now find a blimp on Volcano Island and a truck driving around Desert Island. This adds for a little extra challenge.

As some of you know, before we had really big plans to update Glider Island with larger maps and all new scenery.  But after working a month or so on this all new version we released it would be a completely different game, so we are going to included those changes in Glider Island 2 which will hopefully be ready around Q4 2019, and we went ahead and added a couple new things to the current version to make it ready for prime time on the Oculus Store.

As for the April Tournament winners here are the results:
1st Place on Forest Island: chad_linton wins $15 Amazon Gift Card!
2nd place on Forest Island: mrcheez wins $10 Amazon Gift Card!
3rd place on Forest Island: cmcosta81 15 wins $5 Amazon Gift Card!

To claim your prize, take a screenshot of your steam username within Glider Island to verify your identity and send it to joeysipos@5drealities.com and I will send you your prize!

Good luck to you all next month!

-Joey

You can follow the leaderboards online here: http://www.5drealities.com/Leaderboards.aspx

notes.title: Update 1.13
notes.content:
Hey guys, just released an update to the game that will change up gameplay some...
 [list]
[*]I decided to make the gravity less strong. After watching people play in the arcades they had a hard time keeping airborne, and was a bit too hard for beginners. This will make it easier to get through the map, and speed up the times for the experts at the game. 
[*]Added a warning reminder to "Press Triggers For Rocket Booster" if the user get too slow.
[*]Made some performance tweaks that hopefully will improve framerate some.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.8 And February Tournament Details
notes.content:
Ok, so another major update out here. Some of the updates include:

[h1]Updates:[/h1]
-New Look to the Home Screen! Soaring through the clouds ;)
-When you first start the game it now shows you the Tournament Details. So everyone knows what the prizes are for the month. 
-Update to the Leaderboards. The leaderboards will only show your top score for the month! So this means you can only win once per map. Sorry aboogieman haha ;) I am sure you will still get first place though.
-People from Viveport will soon be able to join the Tournament.
-Rocket Booster update! Now the rockets are separated, so when you press the controller on you left controller, the left booster will fire. In turn this causes you to turn slightly to the right. So if used correctly can help you make sharper turns for example. 
-More updates to the flight physics. The booster had a lot of strength going up, that now has been fixed so gravity acts on you even while boosters are active. This might make things a bit challenging. Feedback would be interesting to hear here.
-New Voice Over from a professional voice actor!
-All new Music!
-New harness for the character! check it out in 3rd person mode!
-Probably a couple more tweaks I can't think of here.

[h1]Tournament Detials:[/h1]
[i] Welcome to the February Tournament!

1st place on Volcano Island will win $25 Amazon Gift Card.
2nd place on Volcano Island will win $15 Amazon Gift Card.
3rd place on Volcano Island will win $5 Amazon Gift Card.
4th place on Volcano Island will win 2 Free Steam Copies of Glider Island.
5th place on Volcano Island will win 1 Free Steam Copy of Glider Island.

Good luck!

Tournament ends February 28th  24:00 UTC Time. Winners will be announced next month.[/i]

notes.title: Update 1.7 Released, Tournament Winners, and More!
notes.content:
Ok, so looks like aboogieman just won every prize for the January Tournament haha. So he will be getting a lot of Steam $$ sent his way. 

Leaderboard changes are coming soon. There was so complications with getting it to work correctly so delayed the leaderboard update for now.

But on the bright side you will notice many new things in the version 1.8 update! The update mainly address ease of use for new comers and arcades. But there is also an added "Advanced Flight Mode" for the more advanced users! Here are some of the new features:

[list]
    [*]New "Basic Mode" and "Advanced Mode". Basic mode is for new comers. you cannot do barrel rolls, flips or go upside down in basic mode. On the contrary, you can do all those things in advanced mode! Please let me know what you think about this added feature!
    [*]New video tutorials to clarify things more clearly.
    [*]New audio instructions to also help out the new comers. Note you can turn the audio instructions off by using the options menu to your right on the main menu.
 [*]New wind effect!
 [*]New booster effect!
 [*]Updated flight physics. You might note gravity might be a tad stronger now ;)
[*]New warning if you have your hands in the wrong position!
[*]Slight graphic updates.
[*]Ability to launch the game outside of Steam.
[*]You can now adjust your camera in 1st person mode!
[*]Removed launch options to only start in SteamVR mode. If you wish to play outside of VR please follow these instructions: http://steamcommunity.com/app/500110/discussions/0/1699415798762148202/
[/list]

Hope you all enjoy! The new leaderboards are coming soon and the prizes will be posted once they are in play - by the first week of February!


Thanks, Joey - Main Dev

notes.title: Tournament Update and some chages coming soon
notes.content:
Alright! aboogiman is still leading on all the leaderboards! Someone needs to step up to the place and challenge this guy.... ;) No, but all to respect, hats off a aboogieman, you are the man!

Just wanted to mention starting February we have some changes coming to the game. First off we will be changing how the leaderboard works. It was suggested (actually by aboogiman himself) that we should make it so you can only have one placement on the scoreboard. This will give others a better chance to also win prizes instead of one person getting all the prizes. So your highest score will be the only one to show. And if you click on your name you will be able to see all your scores. 

Second we are adding a new flight mode to the game. This is for people who want to fly more advanced maneuvers such us flips, upside down flight and barrel roles. It's important we also keep the basic flight mode currently in place for new comers because we don't want them to get disoriented, upside down and confused right off the bat. So there will be two modes to choose from, Basic Flight Mode and Advanced Flight Mode. 

Third we are adding new tutorial videos and voice over instructions to guide new comers and people playing in the arcades. You will be able to disable the voice instructions on the main menu. 

Thanks all for playing, expect the update out starting February!

notes.title: Update 1.5 (Airspeed Indicator and Flight Physics Update)
notes.content:
[b]Flight Physics[/b]
Hey all! We just updated the flight physics so they act a bit more realistic. Before the glider would increase or decrease velocity based on your pitch, and a couple other factors. As this works, it’s not quite how a glider would work in real life. The glider now gains and loses velocity based on how much altitude you lose or gain. As well as looking at the angle of attack. We also programmed in gravity to act correctly. So when you jump, gravity pulls you down and you have to overcome it by gaining lift. Also notice that it is easier to come to a landing as well, by flaring (pitching up and pulling back). Give it a try!

[b]Airspeed Indicator:[/b]
We also added a simple airspeed indicator in the center of your HUD! We had some feedback that it was hard to judge how fast you were going. But now you can use the easy to read airspeed indicator that goes from Red (too slow) to Green (fast) to show your speed. See the screenshot posted!

Let us know what you think! Enjoy and more updates on the way soon.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26154072/ab14b0e1011453fd82db5ace0fc078f98e005e45.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.4 (New Rating System!)
notes.content:
[h1]New Scoring System:[/h1]
So after talking to actual hang glider pilots we realized there is an actual [url=https://www.ushpa.org/legacy/ratings_table.asp] Rating System[/url] for hang gliders! So we decided to upgrade the game to account for this. Your scored is based on how many hoops you collect, and if you collect all the hoops you get a time bonus. (Sorry, old scores have to be erased to account for this) The ratings look like this:

[list]
    [*]H0 - Student Pilot
    [*]H1 - Beginner Pilot
    [*]H2 - Novice Pilot
    [*]H3 - Intermediate Pilot
    [*]H4 - Advanced Pilot
    [*]H5 - Master Pilot
    [*]Bronze (all hoops collected with little time remaining)
    [*]Silver (all hoops collected with moderate time remaining)
    [*]Gold (all hoops collected with lots of time remaining)
[/list]

We also update the User Interface showing the score and awards! Now looks much cleaner and prettier. Some other bugs fixed:

[list]
 [*]Now display score while flying with +1 floating after collecting hoops.
 [*]Fixed an issue with first person mode. Before it would glitch as you turned left and right. Now it is smooth as butter!
 [*]Collision data for the arch under the bridge in Desert Island was too hard. Made the collision data a little wider.
 [*]New Simplified UI after completing flight. Also we show a vertical bar showing where you score ranks. 
[/list]

notes.title: 1.3 Major Update! (VR Arcade Mode)
notes.content:
We have spent the last 2 months polishing the user experience of Glider Island so we can get Glider Island in VR Arcades around the world! When you start Glider Island you will now see these three options:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26154072/0284fd9df049a0f0c471eb5e5502a0304387d834.jpg[/img]

If you start it as a “Normal User” you will get all the normal menu options including Xbox Controller Mode, and Mouse Controller mode. When you start in "Arcade Mode" everything is VR exclusive. This mode is meant for people who have purchased the [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=3303-QWRC-3436] Steam Site Licensing[/url]  and will be showcasing the game in VR Arcades. Also in Arcade mode the score will be visible on the computer monitor so people watching can get an idea of how well the player is doing as they stand behind them.

On top of the new VR Arcade mode we have spent lots of time adding new features to the game. Most of them have to do with improving usability. Here is a list of all the new features:

[b]-User now starts directly at launch pad instead of menu:[/b]
Before the user had to go through 3 steps to enter the glider which was time consuming and confusing. We now reduced it to 1 step!

[b]-New improved way of entering the glider: [/b]
Before the user would have to repositioning themselves to grab the handlebar of the glider which was extremely frustrating for some. Now all the user has to do now is sit up straight and press both triggers and the glider will snap to their position!

[b]-New and improved UI:[/b]
We redid the graphics showing the controls for the glider as well as the how to play the game.

[b]-Oculus Rift Hand Controllers now supported:[/b] 
We made sure if you are using the Oculus Hand Controllers in Steam VR everything works and you get the correct UI/ graphics.

[b]-Much improved hand controller flying mode:[/b]
 This has been totally reworked! We found people would get disorientated because they would end up upside down or crooked. We now simplified this mode so you can no longer get upside down or disoriented. Also the hands are now tracked based off of your heads position, so moving both your head and hands has an effect. So far we have heard people love the new hand controller steering!  

[b]-3rd person mode and 1st person mode:[/b]
The new version now has a fully animated character attached to the glider. So flying in 3rd person mode is more realistic and what you would find in real life. When you enter 1st person mode the camera snaps to the position of the characters head. So you get a first hand experience of what the glider pilot would actually be seeing. 

[b]-Coming soon:[/b]
The next month will be spent creating achievements and leaderboards. We really want to get more of the Steam community involved so we will be adding a monthly tournament mode with prizes at the end of each month. Also looking to have custom leaderboards for Arcade Mode!  More on this to come!

We have been demoing Glider Island around Seattle and each time improving the gameplay from what we learned. Here are some pics/ videos of events we have been at. And be sure to follow Glider Island on [url=https://www.facebook.com/GliderIslandVR] Facebook [/url]  and [url=https://twitter.com/5Drealities] Twitter [/url] 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0SLQbJIG4XQ
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26154072/3ec6aff06b46ded153bf86e648bcb398b7b54a70.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26154072/cdc943ed0cd9fd54bd451db830844c23745404ff.jpg[/img]

Before the user had to go through 3 steps to enter the glider which was time consuming and confusing. We now reduced it to 1 step!

[b]-New improved way of entering the glider: [/b]
Before the user would have to repositioning themselves to grab the handlebar of the glider which was extremely frustrating for some. Now all the user has to do now is sit up straight and press both triggers and the glider will snap to their position!

[b]-New and improved UI:[/b]
We redid the graphics showing the controls for the glider as well as the how to play the game.

[b]-Oculus Rift Hand Controllers now supported:[/b] 
We made sure if you are using the Oculus Hand Controllers in Steam VR everything works and you get the correct UI/ graphics.

[b]-Much improved hand controller flying mode:[/b]
 This has been totally reworked! We found people would get disorientated because they would end up upside down or crooked. We now simplified this mode so you can no longer get upside down or disoriented. Also the hands are now tracked based off of your heads position, so moving both your head and hands has an effect. So far we have heard people love the new hand controller steering!  

[b]-3rd person mode and 1st person mode:[/b]
The new version now has a fully animated character attached to the glider. So flying in 3rd person mode is more realistic and what you would find in real life. When you enter 1st person mode the camera snaps to the position of the characters head. So you get a first hand experience of what the glider pilot would actually be seeing. 

[b]-Coming soon:[/b]
The next month will be spent creating achievements and leaderboards. We really want to get more of the Steam community involved so we will be adding a monthly tournament mode with prizes at the end of each month. Also looking to have custom leaderboards for Arcade Mode!  More on this to come!

We have been demoing Glider Island around Seattle and each time improving the gameplay from what we learned. Here are some pics/ videos of events we have been at. notes.title: Early Access to Full Release
notes.content:
[h1]Milestone reached![/h1] We transitioned from Early Access to Full Release this week! So we welcome all new comers and a want to give a special thanks to the early adopters. Our mission at 5D Realities is to create the most realistic flight experiences for VR and will be feeding off your support! 

We feel Glider Island is in a good state to do the transition and want to open it up for everyone. We have done a lot of work in April to get it to the quality we want and it looks like this is a good time to do the transition. We still have some things we want to add, such as Oculus Hand Controller support and Leader Boards. We will also most likely be working on tweaking the hand controller flying as we add support for the Oculus Motion Controllers coming up so stay tuned.

If you find any bugs are wish to have anything improved in the next update, post your thoughts here and we will try and work them in! Thanks. 

-Joey
5D Realities

notes.title: All New Huge Update!
notes.content:
Special Note: This is our last week in early access! The game is 50% off this week and looking to get back lots of feedback before launch. Get it while its cheep ;)

We have spent the last month redesigning aspects of the game to make it more fun, challenging and polished. Below are a list of the changes. This is quite a dramatic update so feedback is greatly appreciated!

[b] All new redesigned gameplay:[/b] You now have to collect all hoops within 10 minutes to pass each island. Forest Island has 150 hoops, Volcano Island has 175 hoops, and all new Desert Island has 200 hoops. You now must complete each level to unlock the next one. Depending on how fast you complete each level you will receive Gold, Silver, or Bronze. We also updated how the rocket boosters work. Collect the blue spirals now to gain more rocket booster. Be thoughtful in when you choose to collect the blue spirals as you can easily run out of booster…

[b]New Map and Scenery Upgrade:[/b] We have added a 3rd Island! Desert Island. Using Terrain Composer 2 for Unity we have create a beautiful awesome desert/ canyon environment!  Every 2 minutes a sand storm will occur making visibility hard and tricky, so watch out ;)  We have also done some tweaking to the lighting and scenery on the other two islands as well as upgraded the water shaders. There are also some performance improvements as we upgraded to a newer version of Unity. Also note, Forest Island has a cool new lighthouse with light effects! Here is a screenshot of the new island: [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26154072/be1e2c672e537445399022bbbd2842b40d10d0da.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26154072/12393b050a1685e2c8be3418c731ce5f9bc8c349.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26154072/220e1cfb0cb8e8c5002a0a2991fcacf65ec57687.jpg[/img]

[b]New Sound and Music:[/b] Each island now has it's own soundtrack. Composed and created by the developer himself haha. So let me know what you think. There are also a couple new sound effects to replace the old ones.

[b]Updated User Interface:[/b] We have done some updates to the UI, so expect a cleaner and more user friendly look. Here us a look at the main menu. [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26154072/e1817a9bbce3bfc6dae261059d3aad5d46c70673.png[/img]

We are nearing launch day soon! So these two weeks will be the final weeks in early access. If you find any bugs are have any suggestions now is the time to report them, so we can work them into the final build!

We will be adding new screenshots and videos/trailers to the store in the coming weeks.

Note: This update applies to the main branch, the (glider sim) beta branch has not yet been updated.

notes.title: Beta 2 Major Update in the Works.
notes.content:
Our original plan was to release Beta 2 on December 24th. But after having a couple people try it out, it was clear we need much more time to get it to the quality we would like. We need more time to tweak the flight physics and create new challenges and game play. If you would like to help test out Beta 2 before we post it here on steam please send an email to joeysipos@yahoo.com giving the reason why you would like to help test out Beta 2, and if you sound like a good fit we will send you the download. 

In the mean time we have done a update to Beta 1 fixing many bugs and overall making it higher quality. Hopefully this little update will help bring a couple more people into the community before we get to releasing Beta 2. 

Here is a quick glance at what we got working with Beta 2 so far. Still much work needs to be done, but can give you a taste. Thanks for being patient. It's a lot of work to create something worth while. Keep posted.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dO2JB_So7B8&t=3s

notes.title: Vive Hand Controller Update In the Works
notes.content: A lot of people have been requesting the feature to use the Vive's hand controllers to steer the glider. So we are working right now to make that a reality! The way it will work is you reach out to grab the gliders handle bars, then once attached you can take off. Once airborne you can pull back to fly upwards and when you push forward you will fly downwards. To turn left and right you will tilt your hands. Once we have a working prototype in the next week or two we will push out the update for you to try out!

notes.title: Scoring and Gameplay to be revised soon
notes.content:
In our first revision we are looking to fix up the game play to make it more fun! Your feedback on this topic will be very helpful. Here is what we are thinking so far:
 
-The user will race a count down timer from 10 minutes to collect as many hoops as possible. Music getting faster as your time runs out.

-Through the level you will be able to fly through a limited number of "Power Hoops". This will freeze the count down timer for a 20 second interval and any hoops you collect will be double the points.  Think of Packman when eating the big dot (power pellet).

-Every 2 minutes off the count down timer the volcano will erupt or a thunderstorm will occur (depending which level you are flying). Each succession being more intense in severity.

-Bonus points will be added to your score if you collect all the hoops and have time remaining.

- Also a possible level unlocking mechanism. Must earn a silver medal to unlock the next Island.

Let us know what you think by leaving a review below or posting on the discussions page. After this game play fix due out in a week or two we will be working on adding the third island!
